messages:
anya (product): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: the Graybox deal we lost. Can leadership clarify the top reasons and recommended next steps for the roadmap? TL;DR: why did we lose and what do we change?

sam (ceo): Short answer: latency + data residency. They needed sub-50ms token latency and an on-prem pilot within 4 weeks. We couldn't commit to both constraints on their timeline.

julia (sales): Also worth adding: integration support timeline. Their security team wanted an audited on-prem image and a dedicated pilot engineer. Pricing wasn't the blocker — we were within ~10% — it was the time-to-production risk.

mike (product): From product feedback: the customer explicitly asked for a per-tenant eval dashboard and model comparison views. We have Redwood Optimize items that touch this, but not prioritized for enterprise pilots.

anya (product): Can we get an actionable list? Customers asked for: 1) faster pilot onboarding, 2) per-tenant evals and comparison, 3) clearer quantization/cost estimate docs.

eli (cs): Note taken. CS will own pilot runbook + a fast onboarding checklist. I'll pair with eng-infra to define a 2-week pilot path and a template playbook.

sam (ceo): Agreed. Product: move 'tenant eval dashboard' up the backlog to a 2-sprint canary. Eng: create a 'pilot fast-path' that Sales can promise without overcommitting.

mike (product): I'll sketch a short RFC today outlining scope for the eval dashboard. Quick question: does 'pilot fast-path' include a canned infra template or just procedural runbook? If infra template, need eng-infra help.

maya (eng-infra): We can supply a Terraform module + prebuilt image for on-prem pilots and a VPC template for Dedicated. ETA: 3 weeks for initial template, can be accelerated to 2 weeks if we carve out an initial minimal image.

anya (product): Perfect. Also add a one-pager for Sales: 'Why we win / Why we lose' — short bullets and common rebuttals. Reps need something concise to use during calls.

julia (sales): I'll draft that 1-pager and include top rebuttals. Will share a first pass by EOD tomorrow.

sam (ceo): :thumbsup: Can we book a short follow-up to review learnings and action owners? Prefer a focused 30-min rather than waiting for next all-hands.

anya (product): Let's do a 30-min 'Customer loss learnings' sync next Tue at 11am. I'll invite the key owners (Product, Sales, CS, Eng-Infra).

ops-bot: Calendar invite created: "Customer Loss Learnings" — Tue 11:00 — attendees: Anya (product), Sam (ceo), Julia (sales), Mike (product), Eli (cs), Maya (eng-infra).

eli (cs): I'll add the tasks to the CS board and post status updates to #customer-success. Will also capture pilot templates in the shared drive.

anya (product): Thanks all — please add any immediate blockers in thread. We'll capture commitments in the follow-up invite.
_meta: generated for dataset: all-hands Q&A about customer wins/losses and feedback loops
